worldBoss.basis: Predicted, not confirmed: Blizzard documents no order. The boss order and arenas community trackers publish, pinned to a spawn checked in game. First-hand reports show the place in the order shifting between weeks, so each pin is used for 7 days. The second boss of a double spawn takes turns between Nahantu and Skovos; which boss it is varies in first-hand reports, so it is not predicted.

sources.title: The 8-spawn World Boss order and the arena of each spawn that community trackers publish (read 2026-10-23 and 2026-10-24)
A World Boss spawn checked in game, used as the pin
Blizzard forums, first-hand report (2026-09-18): Wandering Death in Nahantu as the second boss of a double spawn
